podcast.body: Released in 1998, this song has become a globally recognized staple, frequently played as an "end of the night" anthem in bars worldwide. It is the primary song for which Semisonic is known by a broad audience. "Closing Time, which has become an end of the night staple at bars around the planet."

"It was a massive hit and got a Grammy nomination for Best Rock Song. You know what? It's Closing Time."
